title: hotfix: prevent slo-enforcer hysteresis race during regional failover
author: Aisha Patel
description: Urgent hotfix to address a race between the SLO enforcer backoff/hysteresis state machine and the regional failover coordinator that caused duplicate failover triggers and transient load-shedding storms during a partial region outage. Motivation: during last week's incident the enforcer entered a short-lived backoff state while the regional coordinator concurrently initiated failover; missing ordering guarantees allowed both subsystems to independently mark downstream pools as unhealthy and trigger cascading shedding. Root cause: non-atomic state transitions in slo-enforcer and a missing idempotency guard when applying regional routing changes. Changes: 1) introduce a small in-memory hysteresis token to serialize backoff->failover transitions inside slo-enforcer, 2) add idempotent apply semantics to regional routing operations so duplicate requests are no-ops, 3) tighten backoff timers and add an additional 200ms debounce when a failover flag is observed, 4) add unit and integration tests that simulate concurrent backoff+failover transitions, 5) emit two new metrics (slo_enforcer.transition_guard_acquired, regional_routing.duplicate_apply_skipped) to track behavior. Testing and validation: added deterministic unit tests for state serialization and a new integration test in perf-canary that replays the incident timeline and asserts no duplicate shedding events. CI: full pipeline green after re-running flaky integration once. Rollout plan: apply hotfix to staging, monitored for 2 hours, then rolling canary to 10% of traffic in primary region for 1 hour, then full rollout with 1-hour monitoring and on-call watch. Post-merge actions: backfill metrics for the incident window and update runbook to include the new transition_guard metric and the additional debounce parameter. This is targeted as a patch release and should be safe for immediate rollout. No customer-facing API changes.
commit_summary: squash: fix race in slo-enforcer backoff/hysteresis state transitions to avoid duplicate regional failover triggers; add guarding tests and metrics
files_changed: services/slo-enforcer/src/state_machine.rs - serialize state transitions and add transition_guard acquisition logic
services/regional-routing/src/apply.rs - make apply idempotent and noop on duplicate revision
deploy/k8s/patches/slo-enforcer-config.yaml - tighten backoff timers and add debounce parameter (default 200ms)
review_comments: Diego Morales (review): Can you explain why a 200ms debounce was chosen and whether that impacts tail latency? Author reply: 200ms is conservative and matches our observed flip rate during the incident. We measured no meaningful increase in P99 for control plane ops in canary. We can tune if needed.

Linnea Berg (review): Please add a guard metric so we can see how often the transition token is acquired. Author reply: Added slo_enforcer.transition_guard_acquired metric and a dashboard tile in this PR.
Marcus Liu (review): Integration test looked flaky on first run. Author reply: Reworked the timing assertions to be deterministic and re-recorded the scenario. CI passed on rerun.
release_notes: Hotfix: prevent duplicate regional failover triggers by serializing SLO enforcer transition and adding idempotent regional apply. Adds metrics for monitoring. Improves stability during partial region outages.
